target: docs/41-试点课堂Start持久迁移内核SDD.md
summary: The revised SDD resolves all first-round P1 blockers. Security approves the isolated test-only Start design, subject to implementation conditions for capability expiry, harness path validation, fingerprint exposure, and fixed executor wiring.

first_round_dispositions.basis: The revised SDD binds commits and receipt lookups to a verified actor, separates owner student identity from the server-created teacher task capability, rechecks owner/account/task scope/reservation, and rejects owner-string authentication and cross-owner existence disclosure.

A separate pilot_e2e-tagged harness artifact, absent from the default server dependency graph, uses a private temporary database, loopback ephemeral port, in-process token and no overrides; production routes are checked absent.

Absent/unreachable receipt lookup returns pending_unknown; it cannot imply rollback or authorize a new ID/effect. Recovery uses the same ID/fingerprint/version/generation and writer serialization; not_committed requires proven rollback.

The canonical fingerprint now binds kind, checkpoint/auth generation, owner/lesson/create fingerprint, plan version and exact candidate; actor authorization precedes receipt replay and replay never executes effects.

Log and persisted payload allowlists, no stable student/lesson IDs in logs, and database/log leak assertions are specified. Keep the candidate-derived SHA-256 fingerprint out of public responses/logs or treat it as guessable metadata; use keyed MAC if it crosses trust boundaries.

additional_finding.title: Fixed wiring and purity of PilotStartExecutor must be preserved
additional_finding.basis: The interface is typed and lacks database access, is test-only, allowlisted to classroom.say and constrained to pure bounded behavior. Go cannot enforce interface purity; implementation must use one fixed non-configurable implementation and prove failures create no rows/effects.

conditions: Enforce capability expiry on commit and receipt lookup.
Reject Windows reparse points when validating harness temporary paths.
Do not emit candidate-derived fingerprints to ordinary logs; avoid exposing them in receipts or use keyed protection across trust boundaries.
Wire only the fixed test-only executor; test error/panic and bounded execution behavior.
limitations: No code changes, tests, runtime checks, build artifact inspection, or deployment validation were performed.
Approval is limited to the test-only created-to-active slice and does not establish implementation correctness or classroom readiness.
